card.name: Punctuation and links in policy lists
card.fires_on: Small joining marks or words (semicolon, quote, closing parenthesis, 'with', 'the', a space) that come just before the next item in a list or clause. The setting is policy, climate and development prose.

modes.label: List separators
modes.description: Semicolons, closing brackets or 'and' that join items in a list of policy points.
modes.example: development activities tend to omit climate change risks<<; >>vulnerability issues need to be addressed

modes.label: Linking words
modes.description: Short words like 'with' or 'the' that lead into the next policy phrase.
modes.example: integration of poverty reduction programs<< with>> other sectoral issues such as environmental management

card.plain: It fires on the small joining marks between points in reports on climate and development policy.
